national.framework: National framework for the assurance of artificial intelligence in government
national.basis: Cornerstones pegged to Australia's AI Ethics Principles (2019)

instruments.title: Policy for the Responsible Use of AI in Government v2.0
instruments.status: Mandatory for non-corporate Commonwealth entities; v2.0 effective 15 December 2025 (replaces v1.1 of 1 September 2024); staged per-requirement implementation deadlines — verify the specific deadline at use. Reported at the 24 September 2026 review (not yet confirmed against the DTA): the first new mandatory requirement applied from 15 June 2026 and the remaining requirements, including AI impact assessments for in-scope use cases, are due by 15 December 2026

instruments.title: NSW AI Assessment Framework (AIAF)
instruments.publisher: Digital NSW / NSW Office for AI
instruments.status: Mandatory for all NSW Government agencies; current Excel AIAF tool published February 2026 (launch date not stated on the official page); system-based version in development; high or critical assessments go to the AI Review Committee

jurisdictions.escalation: AI Review Committee for higher-risk assessments

instruments.title: Foundational AI risk assessment (FAIRA) guideline under the QGEA AI governance policy
instruments.status: Policy and guideline in force from September 2024

instruments.title: WA Government Artificial Intelligence Policy and Assurance Framework
instruments.status: In force; supported by an AI governance toolkit and self-assessment. Official page updated 25 August 2026, after the 14 August 2026 verification — recheck content before use
